messages:
Maya Chen: handing off primary to @Alex for the next 8h. quick summary: INC-2026-13 still active. After the model-routing rollout at 02:12 UTC we saw a spike in 5xx errors and p95 latency for text-gen requests. customer-facing impact: intermittent 503s for a subset of requests hitting gpu-pool-2 (us-west1).

Maya Chen: current state in one line: rollback started but not finished, traffic partially routed to fallback model, alerts still firing. secondary is @Samir. coverage gap to note: between 23:50-00:30 PST there's no SRE overlap (we flagged this earlier).

Tess (incident-bot): [ALERT] INC-2026-13 | InferPipeline: 5xx rate >= 5% (a123) | triggered 1710006120 | current 5.8% | p95 latency 1.34s | impacted clusters: gpu-pool-2(us-west1).

Alex Rivera: acked. taking it. what mitigations are in-flight?

Maya Chen: in-flight mitigations:
- rolling back routing change (v2 -> v1) to reduce model mismatch
- pinned heavy customers to dedicated routing (AcmeCorp -> dedicated-route-1)
- temporarily increased autoscale target for gpu-pool-2 by +2 nodes
- added a short-term prefix cache bypass for very long sequences

Maya Chen: runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-2026-13 (see sections 2 and 4). also there's a checklist in the runbook called "safe-rollout-rollback".

Samir Patel: adding monitoring tips: watch these dashboards: 
- /dashboards/inferring/errors
- /dashboards/inferring/latency-p95
- /metrics endpoint: https://prom.redwood/metrics?match=service:infer*
If you need to throttle, use the rate-limit rule: `rlctl update global --qps 2000` (temp).

Alex Rivera: starting final rollback now. command I'm running:
```
# pin routing back to v1 for model-x
rdctl routing set model-x --variant v1 --force --region us-west1
# scale GPU pool +2 as a precaution
kubectl -n inference scale deploy gpu-pool-2 --replicas=6
```
I'll post outputs.

Alex Rivera: ran rollout command — returned 202 accepted. Scaling job queued. watching logs in /var/log/inference/gpu-pool-2.log.

Tess (incident-bot): [ACTION] Rollback job started by Alex Rivera at 1710007890. ETA ~6m.

Jordan Lee: AcmeCorp CSM pinged: ~20% of their requests got 503 between 02:12-02:30 UTC. they want ETA. recommend we give them a 30m window and offer a postmortem. keep PSR updated.

Alex Rivera: noted. I'll update status page and CSM with ETA 30m. monitoring will tell. immediate goal: get 5xx < 1% and p95 < 1s.

Maya Chen: escalation contacts if rollback doesn't fix: @Jordan (infra lead), @Samir (platform eng). Pager for infra lead: +1-555-0102 (internal).

Samir Patel: if rollback stalls, check KV cache pressure: run `redis-cli -h cache1 info keyspace` and check for high `db0:keys` — we've seen cache thrash cause p95 spikes. Also ensure the KV cache TTLs weren't accidentally shortened in the rollout.

Alex Rivera: rollback completed (status: success), saw routing delta -> 100% v1. waiting for scale up to finish. initial metrics: 5xx down to 3.1%, p95 1.05s. still above target but trending down.

Tess (incident-bot): [METRIC] 5xx rate: 3.1% | p95 latency: 1.05s | check @1710008520

Alex Rivera: next steps for incoming shift:
- watch 5xx for 30m, target <1% ideally within 30m.
- confirm gpu-pool-2 node count stable and no OOMs in logs.
- verify AcmeCorp requests recovering, ping CSM with update at 30m.
- if rollback doesn't hit targets by 30m, escalate to Jordan and start canarying smaller model variants per runbook.

Maya Chen: handoff checklist done: logs + runbook links in case notes; full timeline is in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-13/timeline. Also leaving a local grep command for quick check: `grep -E "ERROR|OOM|503" /var/log/inference/gpu-pool-2.log | tail -n 200`

Alex Rivera: copying notes into shift log now. I'll post final when we hit targets. thanks @Maya. :thumbsup: :coffee:

Maya Chen: thanks — remote now. ping if anything spikes.

Alex Rivera: 30m update (1710016200): 5xx down to 0.6%, p95 0.92s, AcmeCorp reporting normal. marking mitigations stable. leaving secondary monitoring to Samir for overnight.

Samir Patel: noted, I'll keep an eye until 06:00 UTC. no further action planned unless alerts re-trigger.

Jordan Lee: good job team. we'll do a quick post-incident writeup tomorrow and schedule root-cause follow-up.

Maya Chen: closing handoff thread.
